protagonist_identity.role_descriptor: new housekeeper at a snowbound country house
protagonist_identity.note: Human is the unmarked default with no contrary signal; the housekeeper role is stated directly.

epistemic_gap.gap_description: who murdered the master of the house in his locked study, and how, given that all seven guests are lying about something

gap_resolution.note: A fair solution exists, but the Kernel explicitly asks that the player be able to accuse the wrong person, so whether the truth is reached depends on the path taken.
